hook.name: PillHook
hook.description: Collects a flat 1% toll on the ETH leg of all swap forms (exact-in/exact-out, both directions) in a single deployer-pinned pool. Toll accumulates as ERC-6909 claims in the PoolManager and is withdrawable to a fixed vault address via permissionless collect(). The fee rate can only be lowered, never raised, by the deployer.
